Let $A$ denote the given matrix. Expand along the second row. Terms with a zero entry vanish. The cofactor signs are $(-1)^{i+j}$.

$$
\det(A)=5(-1)^{2+1}\begin{vmatrix}2 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & -1 & 1\end{vmatrix}.
$$

Evaluating the smaller determinants gives

$$
\det(A)=-10.
$$
